blind.second_guess: citrus tree in a wooden tub
blind.description: A stylized miniature citrus or orange tree planted in a square wooden tub planter. The tub is made of vertical light wood slats bound by two dark metal iron hoops/bands, with rounded wooden finials atop the four corner posts and four short feet underneath. Inside the planter is brown soil from which a thick, twisted stylized tree trunk emerges, supporting a rounded, dense canopy of layered green leaves laden with plump orange fruits. All geometry is solid, clean, and stylized in a hand-painted game art style with no floating or disconnected parts.
blind.from_above: A dense circular cluster of stylized pointed green leaves speckled with round orange fruits, obscuring the planter underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 feet tall (reaching roughly to mid-chest or around 60% of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height), with a canopy and planter width of approximately 1.5 to 2 feet.
